# onetsolutions_instance_snapshot (Resource)

Manages a snapshot of an instance's disks.

~> **Billing.** An instance includes a number of snapshots in its price; each snapshot beyond that
allowance is **billed** for as long as it exists. Destroying the resource deletes the snapshot and
stops its billing.

Creating a snapshot waits until it is taken; destroying it waits until it is deleted. A snapshot
cannot be changed: every change recreates it. While another operation runs on the instance, the
snapshot waits for it to end, up to the timeout. Once the instance is cancelled or terminated, its
snapshots can no longer be changed: the next refresh removes this resource from the state, and
destroying it succeeds without a change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onetsolutions_instance_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  instance_id = onetsolutions_instance.web.id
  name        = "before-upgrade"
  description = "Taken before the PHP 8.4 upgrade"

  timeouts {
    create = "45m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The UUID of the instance to snapshot. Changing it recreates the snapshot.
- `name` (String) The name of the snapshot, unique on the instance: 3 to 255 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, not starting with a digit. Changing it recreates the snapshot.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the snapshot. Defaults to an empty string; changing it recreates the snapshot.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.
- `project_id` (String) The project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the snapshot was requested (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the snapshot.
- `size_gb` (String) The size of the snapshot in GB, a decimal such as `2.35`; null while unknown.
- `status` (String) The status of the snapshot: `pending`, `present`, `deleting` or `failed`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the creation, as a duration such as "30s" or "2h45m". Defaults to `30m`.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the deletion, as a duration such as "30s" or "2h45m". Defaults to `15m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = onetsolutions_instance_snapshot.before_upgrade
  id = "3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/9a0b1c2d-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d/1d2e3f4a-5b6c-4d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<project_id>/<instance_id>/<snapshot_id>, or <instance_id>/<snapshot_id> when the provider sets organization_id and project_id.
terraform import onetsolutions_instance_snapshot.before_upgrade 3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/9a0b1c2d-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d/1d2e3f4a-5b6c-4d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
```
